description_en: Queries credit usage details by a specified dimension such as user, credit package, or agent
description_zh: 按指定维度查询用户、积分包或Agent的积分使用情况
kebab_example: aliyun wss describe-credit-usage-info --biz-type BUSINESS --usage-type User --instance-ids cp-0bszoespx7o1ehjxs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCreditUsageInfo

parameters.help_en:
The usage type (UsageType). Valid values:

User: Returns the usage, remaining credits, and consumption trends of the current user's active credit packages.
CreditPackage: Requires a CreditPackageId. Returns the total and remaining credits of the specified credit package.
Agent: Requires an AgentId. Returns the cumulative credit usage, cumulative allocated quota, and their percentages
parameters.help_zh:
用量类型（UseageType）：User、CreditPackage、Agent
User：返回用户当前生效积分包的用量、余量及消耗趋势
CreditPackage：需要传入CreditPackageId，返回指定积分包的总量、余量
Agent：需要传入AgentId，返回累计积分用量、累计分配额度及两者百分比
parameters.name: usage_type

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of instance ID list. This parameter can be omitted when `UsageType=User`. Pass the credit package instance ID when `UsageType=CreditPackage`, or pass the `AgentId` when `UsageType=Agent`
parameters.help_zh: 实例 ID 列表 JSON 字符串；`UsageType=User` 时可省略，`CreditPackage` 时传积分包实例 ID，`Agent` 时传 `AgentId`
parameters.name: instance_ids
